brief:
Green Party leader Zack Polanski has called for Palestine Action to be de-proscribed, according to Middle East Eye. The group was designated as a proscribed organization, a legal status that restricts its activities in the United Kingdom.

Polanski's call represents a notable intervention by a senior British political figure into the status of the activist organization, which has faced legal restrictions following its designation.
dek: Green Party leader Zack Polanski calls for de-proscribing Palestine Action Green Party leader Zack Polanski has called for Palestine Action to be de-proscribed, SkyNews reported.
title: Green Party leader calls for de-proscribing Palestine Action
